title: F35 Lighting II Aerial Refuel (471143)
description: U.S. Marine Corps F35B Lighting II assigned to Marine Fighter Attack Squadron 121, Marine Aircraft Group 13, 3d Marine Aircraft Wing(MAW),particpate in aerial refueling missions with KC130J Super Hercules assigned to Marine Aerial Refueler Transport Squadron 352, Marine Air Group 11, 3d MAW at Marine Corps Air Station Yuma, Ariz, June 21, 2016. The mission was to show aerial refueling capabilities for the F35B Lighting II. (U.S Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Jessica Y. Lucio/Released)
